title: Sectionwise formula for set-valued underived exchange
statement: Let $\square$ be a Cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square, def-pc-scheme] with arrows $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $g':X'\to X$, and $f':X'\to Y'$, and let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Define $\operatorname{Ex}^{0,\mathrm{set}}_{\square,F}:g^{-1}f_*F\to f'_*g'^{-1}F$ as the transpose under $f'^{-1}\dashv f'_*$ [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] of $g'^{-1}\varepsilon_f\circ\theta_\square$, where $\theta_\square:f'^{-1}g^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}g'^{-1}f^{-1}$ is the canonical inverse-image comparison $\theta_{\square,G}=c_{f,g',G}^{-1}\circ c_{g,f',G}$ for sheaves of sets $G$ on $Y_{\Et}$, formed from the composition isomorphisms $c_{g,f',G}:f'^{-1}g^{-1}G\xrightarrow{\sim}(g\circ f')^{-1}G$ and $c_{f,g',G}:g'^{-1}f^{-1}G\xrightarrow{\sim}(f\circ g')^{-1}G$ of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] and the equality $g\circ f'=f\circ g'$ of the square. For an etale object $V\to Y'$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], a presheaf representative (an element of the presheaf inverse image whose sheafification is the set-valued inverse image of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]) of a section of $g^{-1}f_*F$ is $(W\to Y,\ a:V\to Y'\times_YW\text{ over }Y',\ s\in F(X\times_YW))$. Put $A=X'\times_{Y'}V$ [def-pc-fibre-product] and let $\ell_a:A\to X'\times_X(X\times_YW)$ be induced by the square and $a$. The image of the sheafified class [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of $(W,a,s)$ under $\operatorname{Ex}^{0,\mathrm{set}}_{\square,F}$ is the restriction of $s$ along $\ell_a$ [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], after applying the inverse-image unit $F\to g'_*g'^{-1}F$; equivalently it is $\ell_a^*(\eta_{g',F}(X\times_YW)(s))\in(g'^{-1}F)(A)=(f'_*g'^{-1}F)(V)$. The rule is independent of representatives and natural in $F$.

source.place: Tag 0EZR, proof of lemma-base-change-local, restriction identities on presheaf representatives

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], the inverse image $g^{-1}(f_*F)$ is the sheafification of the presheaf whose value at $V\to Y'$ is the colimit over pairs $(W\to Y,a:V\to Y'\times_YW)$ of $(f_*F)(W)$; by the same node and the definition of direct image, $(f_*F)(W)=F(K)$ for $K=X\times_YW$. Thus every presheaf representative is exactly $(W,a,s)$ as in the statement. The fibre-product universal property [def-pc-fibre-product] gives the induced map $\ell_a:A\to X'\times_XK$, and the target direct image has value $(f'_*g'^{-1}F)(V)=(g'^{-1}F)(A)$ by the set-valued direct-image formula in [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units].

source.place: Tag 0EZR, proof of lemma-base-change-local, restriction identities on presheaf representatives

proof.text: For a representative put $r_{V}(W,a,s)=\ell_a^*(\eta_{g',F}(K)(s))$. If $h:W_1\to W_2$ and $a_2=(\mathrm{id}_{Y'}\times h)a_1$, write $k=\mathrm{id}_X\times h:K_1\to K_2$. The unit compatibility in clause (0) of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] gives $(\mathrm{id}_{X'}\times_Xk)^*\eta_{g',F}(K_2)(s)=\eta_{g',F}(K_1)(k^*s)$; functoriality of fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product] gives $\ell_{a_2}=(\mathrm{id}_{X'}\times_Xk)\ell_{a_1}$, so the two representatives have the same image. For $v:V_1\to V_2$, the same universal-property calculation gives $\ell_{av}=\ell_a(\mathrm{id}_{X'}\times v)$, so $r$ commutes with restrictions. Hence the $r_V$ form a presheaf morphism.

source.place: Tag 0EZR, proof of lemma-base-change-local, restriction identities on presheaf representatives

proof.text: The target presheaf is the sheaf $f'_*g'^{-1}F$ by the set-valued direct-image assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. The universal property of sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] therefore extends $r$ uniquely to a morphism $\psi:g^{-1}f_*F\to f'_*g'^{-1}F$. Consequently equal sheafified classes have equal images, proving independence of representatives. Naturality in $F$ follows from the unit naturality in clause (0) of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] and the functoriality of restriction maps.

source.place: Tag 0EZR, proof of lemma-base-change-local, restriction identities on presheaf representatives

proof.text: It remains to identify $\psi$ with the exchange morphism. Let $H=f_*F$. Evaluating $g_*\psi\circ\eta_{g,H}$ on an etale object $W\to Y$ and on $s\in H(W)=F(K)$ uses the identity representative $(W,\mathrm{id},s)$: by [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] the set-valued $g^{-1}$ is $u_s$ for $u=-\times_YY'$ of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-functor-sheaf-pullback-adjunction] (2), whose adjunction $g^{-1}\dashv g_*$ is the composite of $u_p\dashv u^p$ and of sheafification; the unit of $u_p\dashv u^p$ at $s\in H(W)$ is the coprojection at $(W,\mathrm{id}_{W\times_YY'})$ by [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-pullback-sets-left-exact] (1), so $\eta_{g,H}(W)(s)=g^*s$ is the sheafified class of $(W,\mathrm{id},s)$ (with $W\times_YY'=Y'\times_YW$ canonically [def-pc-fibre-product]), and $\psi$ sends it to $r(W,\mathrm{id},s)$ by step 3. It gives the map $\delta_W:F(K)\to(g_*f'_*g'^{-1}F)(W)$ obtained by first applying $\eta_{g',F}(K)$ and then restricting along the canonical fibre-product isomorphism $X'\times_XK\simeq X'\times_{Y'}(Y'\times_YW)$. This is natural in $W$ by [def-pc-fibre-product], so $\delta=g_*\psi\circ\eta_{g,H}$.

source.place: Tag 0EZR, proof of lemma-base-change-local, restriction identities on presheaf representatives

proof.text: Under the composite set-valued adjunction $f'^{-1}g^{-1}\dashv g_*f'_*$ supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], the adjunct of $g'^{-1}\varepsilon_f\circ\theta_\square$ is the same $\delta$. Indeed, the unit equation for the composition isomorphisms in that node rewrites its adjunct as $d\circ f_*g'_* (g'^{-1}\varepsilon_f)\circ f_*\eta_{g',f^{-1}H}\circ\eta_{f,H}$, where $d:f_*g'_*g'^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\sim}g_*f'_*g'^{-1}F$ is the fibre-product comparison just computed. Naturality of $\eta_{g'}$ and the triangle identity for $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$ reduce this to $d\circ f_*\eta_{g',F}=\delta$. Since the composite adjunct of $g'^{-1}\varepsilon_f\circ\theta_\square$ is $g_*\operatorname{Ex}^{0,\mathrm{set}}_{\square,F}\circ\eta_{g,H}$ (first transpose under $f'^{-1}\dashv f'_*$, then under $g^{-1}\dashv g_*$), we get $g_*\operatorname{Ex}^{0,\mathrm{set}}_{\square,F}\circ\eta_{g,H}=\delta=g_*\psi\circ\eta_{g,H}$ by step 4, and injectivity of the hom bijection of $g^{-1}\dashv g_*$ gives $\operatorname{Ex}^{0,\mathrm{set}}_{\square,F}=\psi$. This also proves the stated formula and its naturality.
